title: credit.low payload v1
description: A draw took the holder's available balance of a feature from above the policy's low-credit threshold to at most it, and not to zero ("N visits left"). Made once per crossing, not on every draw below it. No postings: the draw's own event carries the balance move.

available.description: The holder's available balance of the feature after the mutation, in the feature's credits.

threshold.description: The policy's lowCreditThreshold when the event was made.

previous_available.description: The available balance before the mutation (above `available`: these events come from a draw).
